android.desc:
Wear your memories on your wrist! Want to easily show off your best photos? With PhotoWear Classic™, you can easily display any of your favorite nine photos right from your smartwatch! Whether it’s a recent trip you took or pics of your grand kids, build memories and share them with your friends or keep them for yourself. 

Enjoy the free version or upgrade to PhotoWear Classic Pro for additional features.

SELECT 9 of your favorite photos from your phone's gallery
TOGGLE between photos right from your watch face

☆☆☆ COMPATIBILITY ☆☆☆

PhotoWear Classic is compatible with Android Wear OS watches and select Samsung watches, including the Galaxy Watch4 and Watch5, the Google Pixel, and Fossil Gen 6.

Watches shipped with Wear OS 5.X, including Google Pixel 3 and the Samsung Galaxy Watch7 series, are NOT currently supported.

PhotoWear Classic NO LONGER supports Samsung/Tizen-based smartwatches (including the Gear S3, Sport, and legacy Galaxy series).

PhotoWear Classic NO LONGER supports the older generation of smartwatches running the legacy Android Wear OS 1.X, including the original Asus ZenWatch, LGE G Watch, Samsung Gear Live, Sony SmartWatch 3, and the Moto 360. 

Read more about PhotoWear compatibility here: https://link.squeaky.dog/photowear-classic-compatibility

If you're looking for help with PhotoWear Classic, please see our online knowledge base (https://link.squeaky.dog/photowear-classic-help), check out our video tutorials on YouTube (https://link.squeaky.dog/photowear-classic-video-playlist), or you can open a support ticket by emailing us at support@squeaky.dog.

☆☆☆ HIGHLIGHTED FEATURES ☆☆☆

FREE features:
- Digital watch face
- Crop your photos and apply photo filters
- Interactive watch face lets you select album view or tap to display any of 9 photos full screen

PRO Features:
- Additional beautiful clock style choices
- Change options like text font, battery indicator, and time position
- And many more customizations!

☆☆☆ Staying in Touch ☆☆☆

Join the **PhotoWear Classic** community and stay up to date with feature development and other valuable information. Sign up for PhotoWear Classic News & Updates here: https://link.squeaky.dog/photowear-classic-newsletter. We do not send many emails and you can unsubscribe at any time.

quotes.text: Me and my husband had been developing our own Android apps published to Google Play for a while and never made much money. But when Android Wear first came out, we started developing watch faces (mostly ones we wanted for ourselves) and persistence finally paid off. Income varies, but we've been steadily making between $500 and $1500/month. These are the top two: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sparkistic.justaminute and https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sparkistic.photowear
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: Those making $500+/month on side projects in 2017 – Show and tell
